Command `cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/mkfont.py <<'PY'
import struct, binascii
# Build minimal sfnt with a post table version 1.0 and enough padding/text32 tail.
def tag(s): return s.encode('ascii')
post = struct.pack('>I I h h I I I I I', 0x00010000, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)  # 32 bytes
# sfnt header with one table
num=1
sfnt_version=0x00010000
# searchRange etc for 1 table: 16,0,0
header=struct.pack('>IHHHH', sfnt_version,num,16,0,0)
offset=12+16*num
# align offset 4 yes 28
checksum = sum(struct.unpack('>%dI' % ((len(post)+3)//4), post + b'\0'*((-len(post))%4))) & 0xffffffff
record=tag('post')+struct.pack('>III', checksum, offset, len(post))
font=header+record+post
# Append 64 bytes so fuzzer text32 tail has cp 1 in last element; note appended bytes after table harmless.
tail=bytearray(64)
# UTF-32 native copied from file on little endian into uint32_t; set text32[15]=1 by last 4 bytes little endian
struct.pack_into('<I', tail, 60, 1)
font += tail
open('/workspace/poc_min_post1','wb').write(font)
print(len(font), binascii.hexlify(font[:64]))
